message: リンガー
Coming out of the photo shop, Azel handed the change to Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks for your business!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Let me see.」
An envelope is thrust toward us.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... Huh...」
A photo printed out from digital camera data.
It's a commemorative photo of Ringer, who's returning to the Demon World tonight.
In front of Yuugiri-an, with Ringer in the middle, me, Nanaka, Nanaka's dad and mom, and the three members of the Delicious Food Squad are lined up together happily.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, uncharacteristically, Ringer's looking nervous」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you're right」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't see it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, his gaze is weirdly straight ahead」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, his arms （?） are completely symmetrical, he's stiff as a board from nerves」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For a death metal musician, he's pretty shy」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, what about the theremin?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At Yamanba-san's」

name: Synn
message: 「He was able to buy it with his part-time pay. Good for him」

name: Synn
message: 「He said he was interested in the theremin」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Azel
message: 「Why, to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Because on the first day, you were taking photos, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you coming to Ringer's farewell party?」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested」
Azel spun around on his heel.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait!」
To Azel, who turned back with an annoyed look, I handed over two photos I had taken out of an envelope.

name: Synn
message: 「Ringer asked me to give these to you」
In his own room, which had nothing in it besides a bed, Azel was looking at the photos.
In front of Yuugiri-an, with Azel in the center, Synn, Nanaka, Nanaka's parents, and the three members of the Delicious Food Squad were lined up amicably.
As thanks for taking their picture, Ringer had taken it with Azel's digital camera. Though saying he took it really just meant pressing the button.

name: Azel
message: 「Ringer, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「To think the day would come when I would actually remember their names」

name: Azel
message: 「...How pointless」
Muttering that, Azel went to throw the photos into the trash can, but
In the end, he pinned them up on the wall with thumbtacks right next to the one he had taken himself.
